reason: This plugin is primarily a media-capable chat plugin that extends DeepSeek Harness with image understanding and optional local voice interaction by routing multimodal tasks to configured providers. Its user-facing behavior centers on multimodal conversation support and media handling, with optional local TTS and tool-based image inspection features.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的多模态聊天插件，用于将图片附件交给本地或可选远程模型进行理解，并提供可选的本地实时语音输入与语音回复。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness multimodal chat plugin that routes image-based tasks to local or optional remote models and supports optional local realtime voice input with spoken responses.

capabilities: Image attachment intake and conversion of vision tasks into text-based model inputs
Routing between local and remote multimodal providers via configurable priorities and provider IDs
Optional local realtime voice capture/transcription and TTS playback through managed MLX-Audio runtime
Caching/archiving of processed images and results
Optional filesystem image analysis via explicit `inspect_image` tool

reasons.code: README shows image upload paths (paperclip, drag-and-drop, clipboard) and an explicit tool contract for `inspect_image` that passes image paths into multimodal analysis.
README describes provider model configuration for Ollama and OpenAI-compatible endpoints with optional remote fallback and explicit provider selection.
package.json exposes `dsh-multimodal-router` CLI (`setup-tts`) and an optional managed `mlx-audio` Python runtime dependency for local speech synthesis.
